definition.name: Move Floor Sketch Corner to Shared Point
definition.description: Moves one corner of a floor's sketch to a shared E/N point, keeping arc bulges on adjoining edges.
definition.aiDescription: Moves one corner of a floor's sketch to a shared E/N point, keeping arc bulges on adjoining edges. Runs with manual transactions (its own transactions and edit scopes, one undo step).
examples: move this floor corner to these coordinates
snap the plot floor vertex to the surveyed point
